gen-gf-bellota-gf-arvo: Distinctive and sturdy, Bellota draws its s with ends that hang far from the spine, every stroke traced like one stylus. Arvo, a classic serif, gives it a dignified, grounded partner.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-belgrano: Commanding from the first word, Bellota has an o whose sides and top are equally thick, like a stylus line. And Belgrano, a serif with open-mouthed curves, gives it a traditional, quiet partner.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-biorhyme: Distinctive is the first impression of Bellota, with an s whose ends hang far from the spine and no hairlines anywhere. BioRhyme, a refined serif, brings widely spaced capitals and brush-like curve endings that answer it nicely.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-biorhyme-expanded: Commanding in tone, Bellota keeps a single-width stroke in every glyph, with an s whose ends hang far from the spine. But BioRhyme Expanded, a bookish text serif, gives open gaps and a clear e that keep paragraphs easy to move through.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-biz-udmincho: Bellota's s hangs its ends far from the spine, every curve as thin as drawn thread. Its heading voice is bold and showy, while BIZ UDMincho, a bookish serif with shallow terminal curls, handles the quieter job of carrying the text.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-copse: Copse reads literary and light, with daylight showing through every curved opening of its serif letters. Bellota adds the distinctive part, an s with far-hanging ends and n arches as thick as the stems beside them.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-cutive: Cutive reads refined and literary, its wide tracking giving a serif text generous c openings. Bellota, with its far-hanging s ends and fixed-nib look, suits a heading size well above the Cutive text.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-david-libre: Bellota's ruler-straight line weight and far-hanging s ends make it the most striking thing here. Yet David Libre, a dignified serif with terminals that hang open, calmly handles the reading.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-enriqueta: Enriqueta reads literary and dignified, its chalk-like curves stopping well before they close. Bellota adds a pen-plotter smoothness and an s with far-hanging ends, so give the Enriqueta text a little extra size.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-fenix: Bellota glows like neon tube, one steady line thickness with an s whose ends hang far from the spine. Fenix, a classic serif with curved strokes that end before turning inward, gives that glow an editorial footing.
